justification: Detected: the package contains 7 production classes totaling 2263 LOC (`core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/qrcode/encoder/*.java`), with large central classes `Encoder.java` (648 LOC), `MinimalEncoder.java` (667 LOC), and `MatrixUtil.java` (477 LOC). `Encoder.java` alone handles mode selection, version selection, bit termination, Reed-Solomon EC generation/interleaving, mask selection, and matrix assembly; `MaskUtil.java`, `QRCode.java`, `ByteMatrix.java`, and `BlockPair.java` support the same pipeline, showing this package centralizes most QR-code encoding responsibilities rather than a narrowly focused concern.
